[h1] 6 / 10 But has lots of potential [/h1] First of all, I would wish the most for Coop. No need to make it mega safe, just stick to private lobbies. [b][u] Economy: [/u][/b] - Feels not required to have / non existent after that first placement [u]Suggestion:[/u] - Nerf Self gathering - Make housing the resource for minions instead of buildable land tiles. In that regard, make some houses functional such as granaries or warehouses. (That can be destroyed and should be defended (Losable resources)) - Add more Economy, such as pesants and things to keep them happy to tax some gold. Or something simmilar. Though I would also recommend having people joining the castle be quite slow so defending the pesants has a reason. Pesants will also be a good resource to make soldiers. - Also add more variety, such as different animals that give different resources. (Possibly some that can even attack enemies or allies) - At the end of a fight, rebuilding the castle should not be free in my opinion. - Make soldiers more expensive when upgraded (or instead of upgrading them with gold make it possible to have npcs craft armors and swords for them, that way iron would finally have a use) [b][u] Combat: [/u][/b] - Feels not very impactful no matter if its sword, longbow or magic. (Even when upgraded) - Archers are very annoying to kill when they run from you immediately - Not enough options for me personally, but no problem as this is a fresh release [u]Suggestion:[/u] - Add impact frames for heavy strikes / damage - Different Melee Weapon Types such as: Longsword, Shortsword, Dagger, Mace, etc. - Different Ranged Weapon Types such as: Crossbow, Longbow, Shortbow, (maybe repeater crossbows and muskets in lategame or something) - Different Magics / Artifacts such as: Elemental Magic ( already implemented to some extend ), Magic weapons / Armor / Gear - Different Armors (Light for movement speed, Heavy for tanking, Medium as balanced option) - Different Damage Types such as: Pierceing Damage, Blunt Damage, Slashing Damage and Magic Damage to have more control over balance [b][u] Progression: [/u][/b] - Too Fast and sudden - No real early / lategame upgrades [u]Suggestion:[/u] - Improve some upgrades, lock those behind certain requirements. (I know some upgrades have minimal requirements, but it doesnt really feel any hinderance) - Instead of having all upgrades being paid by gold, make a currency (like Levels earned from XP) that is only gained for kills and rounds survived. With general improvements like that, this could easily become one of my favorite games.

有很多游戏的影子，感觉画风像我的世界，一波次一波次的塔防玩法又像3D版王权陨落， 有时候还有点亿万僵尸的既视感，不过玩起来还是挺上头的，而且还有村民和工人帮你种田和建造。 [h3]建造城堡，保护国王[/h3] 因为敌人会以波次的形式出现，从而对国王进行攻击，因此玩家就需要建造起一个防御措施，从城墙到尖刺陷阱，磁力陷阱，再到弓箭手，士兵，大型弩，大型炮塔，不过都需要玩家通过获取的钱财逐渐解锁，但放置这些也需要材料，因此采集的过程也很重要，除此之外玩家也可以加入到战斗之中，如果玩家死亡后可以在CD内复活战场，如果玩家在城堡里可以操纵大炮等攻击敌人。不过国王死亡就需要重新挑战这一波次了。而游戏的最后一道屏障就是国王也有战斗能力。通过技能树给剑，镐子，锤子等进行升级，除此之外升级系统还包含防御和城堡。 获得胜利后的解锁会出现国王雀跃的动画，而在此阶段游戏中会统计受损的元素和装置，玩家可以点击修复，除此之外随着波次敌人也会越来越强，从普通的骷髅小兵到弓箭手再到投石器再到装甲车等，如果你觉得自己一切都准备就绪了，也可以提前按下黑暗祭坛召唤敌人，而提前的好处就是会有金币倍率奖励。 [h3]在方块世界中探索[/h3] 游戏有不同的地图风格，比如说在青青草原上摇曳的小花，还有一层一层往上叠加的山坡和陆地和远处的蓝天白云，再加上背景音乐倒是有种人民生活比较美好的感觉（虽然经常受到骷髅兵入侵）。而怪来临时的昏暗则会与之形成鲜明对比，天空中乌云密布，只有远处的传送门，和天空上向我方飞来的敌人，满屏幕都是战争的阴暗感，不过站在高高的城墙上俯视下方意外的宏伟壮观，除此之外你还能见到环境险峻的沙漠地带(沙漠的音乐有种埃及的感觉，还有一种一片荒芜的感觉)，被白色包裹的雪地等。 在地面上挖掘，可以挖到一些材料外还可以随机挖到金币，玩家日常可以去砍伐树木，搭建城堡，放置武器，而城堡的搭建也是需要的用心思考和射击的，比如我觉得墙要高要厚，城堡的范围要大，而弓箭手弩这些武器要放在高处，城墙的四周要放置好陷阱，城墙上也可以旋转尖刺陷阱放置一些贴墙式的，最重要的还有升级和资源的采集，比如说木墙变石墙，城堡的设计也可以一环扣一环，就是一个墙内还是墙。 比较方便的是，比如说在建造农田和城墙时，可以快速拉出一个框架，然后让工人进行填充制造 [h3]其他[/h3] 游戏中比较可爱的就是在一些提示中比如又招募了一位工人，这里建造不了之类的会有语音提示，或者说在一些敌人即将来临，黑魔法变弱敌人即将消失的时刻，即使没有语音也会屏幕上文字提示，游戏的文字为像素风，很符合这种方块质感。游戏右方有任务提示，当然你也可以按自己的想法来。 本作每次波次开始之前都会有小动画，当然你也可以选择跳过，或者用动画脑部出一系列剧情，整体来说本作的环境氛围做的还是不错的，沙漠的大太阳真的有点刺眼。 每一个大型地图完成后，玩家可以选择留在此处继续推进，当然也可以进入下一关。 [quote]漫话漫谈，期待关注:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44551694/]写生漫话家[/url] ←节约宝贵时间，阅读省流测评~ 欢迎加入漫话家的大家庭:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/14030826]写生漫话家[/url]←共同探讨游戏中的精彩片段，向玩家展现第九艺术的魅力~ 感谢你的阅读，觉得还行的话，希望点个赞~[/quote] 最后 游戏目前的汉化还不是很完全，期待正式版更新更多的内容，比如道具，武器，敌人，建造物之类的。

Early Access review as of 7/24/25. Steam doesn’t offer a "mixed" rating, but that’s where this sits. There are 3 islands with 15 waves each (though you can keep waving each island, but there isnt point to that other than additional income). I completed all achievements in ~8 to 10 hours on Mere Mortal difficulty and some unexpected afk time too bringing playtime to 13+ hrs. The core game loop works and it’s fun, but is limited. At the current price, it doesn’t feel worth it unless a lot more content is added. Needs * Additional islands with new challenges * More achievements to support progression, maybe even different ones on each of the difficulty tiers * Explore passive income, building, and reworking long-term progression * Maybe a roguelite / endless style alternative progression track Dev, I am happy to change this to a positive review if future updates deliver more substance, but as stated, my main gripe is a $20 price tag. Players, if you don't mind the price you should check out the demo as that is close to 1/3 of the game. Overall I'm happy with the game, but unsatisfied its already over.

[h1][b]【童年游戏之攻占堡垒的精神续作】[/b][/h1] [h2][b]推荐指数：7/10[/b][/h2] [h2][b]评测配置：3080ti+12900kf+48G[/b][/h2] (Chinese/English) [h2][b]优点：[/b][/h2] 1. ‌方块的世界(我的世界玩家狂喜) 2. 有趣的教程 3. 精美的画质 4. 高高的自由度 5. 丰富的建筑种类 6. 完美的平衡性 7. 无尽的模式 8. 第一章的资源会继承到下一章 [h2][b]缺点：[/b][/h2] 1. 中文汉化不全，汉化文本量一半都没有 2. 建造放置方块时每次都会卡顿一下(大约0.1s) 3. 建造视角的摄像机设计不是很人性化，使用起来略感笨拙 4. 建造视角无法穿墙，导致当你建了复杂的工事时需要手动钻出去外面 5. 建造视角有时不会记录你上次关闭的位置，特别烦人，本来移速就慢 6. 后期怪多会掉帧，本人设置144帧上限，会掉到40帧左右 7. 经常遇到怪被卡在坑里不动的情况 8. 建造方块后，如果木头方块或者石头方块建错了，可以使用回收功能进行取消。但是泥土方块不行，当我不小心放了几百个泥土方块后，无法通过回收功能进行取消 9. 当我招募超过50个建筑工后，大量AI罢工不干活 10. 建筑工一直吹口哨特别烦人，招募数量多了后口哨频率更明显 [h2][b]希望改进的地方：[/b][/h2] 1. 完善中文汉化 2. 为建造模式添加"S-h-i-t"键加速移动，目前移速太慢 3. 为建造模式添加穿墙功能，如果建造模式在建筑内展开的话，需要弯弯绕绕通过实体碰撞来到外面，而不是直接穿墙到外面 4. 更多的士兵单位上限，目前只能放三个单位根本体会不到大战场的感觉，玩到后期没什么爽感 5. 改进AI行为 [h2][b][Translator] Advantages:[/b][/h2] 1. World of Blocks (Minecraft players ecstatic) 2. Interesting tutorials 3. Exquisite picture quality 4. High degrees of freedom 5. Rich types of buildings 6. Perfect balance 7. Endless Mode 8. The resources in the first chapter will be inherited into the next chapter [h2][b][Translator] Disadvantages:[/b][/h2] 1. Chinese localization is incomplete, with half of the text not being translated into Chinese 2. When building and placing blocks, there will be a lag every time (about 0.1 seconds) 3. The camera design with a construction perspective is not very user-friendly, and it feels a bit clumsy to use 4. The construction perspective cannot penetrate the wall, resulting in the need to manually drill out when building complex fortifications 5. Sometimes the construction perspective does not record the position you closed last time, which is particularly annoying. The movement speed is already slow 6. In the later stage, if there are too many monsters, frames will drop. I have set a maximum of 144 frames, which will drop to around 40 frames per second 7. Often encounter situations where monsters are stuck in the pit and not moving 8. After building blocks, if wooden or stone blocks are built incorrectly, the recycling function can be used to cancel them. But the soil blocks are not good. When I accidentally put hundreds of soil blocks, I cannot cancel them through the recycling function. 9. When I recruited over 50 construction workers, a large number of AI went on strike and stopped working 10. The construction workers keep whistling, which is particularly annoying. As the number of recruits increases, the frequency of whistling becomes more pronounced [h2][b][Translator] Areas for improvement:[/b][/h2] 1. Improve Chinese localization 2. Add the "S-h-i-t" key to the construction mode to accelerate movement, but the current movement speed is too slow 3. Add a through wall function to the construction mode. If the construction mode is unfolded inside the building, it needs to be bent and collided with entities to reach the outside, instead of directly passing through the wall to the outside 4. With more soldier unit limits, currently only three units can be deployed, which cannot fully experience the feeling of a large battlefield. Playing until the later stage does not provide much excitement 5. Improve AI behavior

Okay, I’ll put it this way: the reviews for this game feel unnecessarily harsh. This is a very small studio, and the game is exactly what it claims to be in the ads. Honestly, I’m surprised at how accurately the video reflects the actual gameplay—that alone deserves more positive recognition. If you watched the trailer, thought you’d enjoy it, bought the game, and then didn’t like it… that’s kind of on you. The core gameplay loop is clearly shown in the trailers and screenshots—it even has a demo. If you’re reviewing it based only on the demo and being overly critical, that feels pretty unfair. there is 1 review by LinWasTaken that i feel like has some valid criticism, but i dont think it justifies a "dont recommend" spot.. but thats just me I’ve seen people call the game “clunky” or say it feels like early access. From my experience, it runs well. I think what people really mean is that it could use more quality-of-life features—like an in-game wiki or help section explaining certain mechanics (for example, how large forestry areas need to be before you gain additional lumberjacks), or clearer ways to manage tasks like dismantling placed structures beyond just dirt tiles. And if some of these features already exist, that just reinforces the need for better in-game explanations. Some modes, like skirmish, do feel underdeveloped and clearly designed with room to expand. So I can understand why someone might say “early access,” but that’s not quite how I’d describe it. It feels more like a small dev team that could’ve benefited from more time and resources to fully flesh out features like skirmish mode and polish the world editor. But “clunky”? Not really. I’m not sure what people are comparing it to—it honestly runs and plays better than a lot of AAA games these days, and overall what you can play is solid and well polished, with room to improve and mainly "expand" big difference between expand and improve and this game is mostly "expand" One thing worth pointing out is how skirmish mode connects to the world editor. As far as I can tell, you can’t play skirmish without first creating or selecting a map from the editor—and there don’t seem to be any premade maps available. There’s a “workshop” button and prompts suggesting community-made maps, so the system clearly exists—but there’s nothing on Steam to actually browse or download them. That makes it feel like a missing or incomplete feature. More broadly, some content and systems feel underdeveloped—but again, “clunky” isn’t the word I’d use. The core gameplay loop feels solid, and I can easily see future updates improving things. As for the campaign, it’s mostly complete. I noticed a few minor issues with unit AI at times, and I do wish certain mechanics were explained better (like forestry scaling). But realistically, these are small complaints—especially considering the size of the dev team. I have more fingers on one hand than they have developers. Overall, I definitely recommend this game. im kinda addicted and my duaghter asked "is it on switch" and unfortunately its not but she wants to play as well.... That said, if it doesn’t receive post-launch support with regular updates and improvements, I’d revise that to “recommend only on sale.” 1 thing i wish it had is co-op, it would be pretty cool, i could see me playing this with my kid and having absolute blast playing.. but if it doesnt happen I wont complain so Swiss people who crafted this game.. if you find it worth while sometime adding co-op would be greatly appreciated by atleast 1 person in the world

I really want to like this game. It has a cool concept and a lot of potential. But I can’t recommend it in good faith right now. The game is suffering from major scaling issues, confusing UI, and poor guidance on how to advance. In my opinion it’s a 3/10 at its current state and the 3 is only coming from the concept and design. For my ADHD brethren, here’s a quick breakdown: Scaling is awful, progression feels awful, the UI is confusing, and the game doesn’t explain important mechanics. All of this makes the game unfun to play and makes it very macro heavy just for a crumb of success or fun. Lets talk about the scaling issue, by far the biggest issue. I think if the developers can fix this issue it would give players a lot of leniency on the other issues and give the game time to grow. -Currently I have a 5/10 sword, and it does 34 damage per strike and 100 damage on the final combo thrust. Enemies at wave 7 can have hp between 540-1.5k hp. There is no reason why I have a half way maxed sword and its doing 34 damage, you’ve got to be kidding me. -The bow costs 300 gold just to get started, and with it at level 2, does 150 damage but takes 3 seconds to reload each time. When you are fighting a wave of enemies, the bow is too slow to use. By the time you fire off 5 shots, the wave is already at your door. The point is to keep them back with the bow before they reach the gate. -The telekinesis barely works half the time, you can throw a rock at an enemy and it will just build on top of them instead of hitting them and the damage again is like 100 a hit, IF you hit them, its just not reliable enough to count on. -The ballista is just the bow, with a longer cooldown. It does LESS damage than the bow, and it takes like I think 6 seconds to reload? -The traps don’t really do much damage either and the other traps that cost metal are too expensive to build to defend a whole castle. -I literally had on wave 6 flying enemies with 1.5k hp fly over me and my wall and kill my king. Accidentally restarted the round and instead got giants that can hit you so hard you only have 1 bar left. Wave 6. 50 mins in your game. -You want players to start the wave early so that they can earn more gold at the end of the round right? That's why you made that a feature right? So how are players supposed to do that if it takes 5 waves to just build a decent wall and if that wall isn’t thick enough the enemies literally smash right through it even with tier 2 walls. After wave 5 if you don't have a 4x4 tier 2 wall at least you are not surviving the waves after. -Also only 220 gold for wave 9? I make more money literally digging dirt. - So they're skeleton boomers that when they go boom they leave bones so that enemies can climb and scale your wall right. So the obvious think to do is to kill them before they go boom right? Nope, they explode regards and leave bones anyways. Why. Basically, nothing in this game feels fun to use unfortunately. You think you are upgrading to something cool but it just disappoints. Second issue, your building tool. When you upgrade your pickaxe it feels like it did nothing. Upgrading it doesn’t make it faster, doesn’t make it gather more resources or gather them faster, and it stays the same speed. Like, digging dirt to lay a foundation or making sure there isn't holes in your wall take soooo long. Its so mind numbing it hurts. Please increase the speed on this thing, or make special tools that do jobs faster because 1 block a second is really killing me man. It really feels like the game gaslights you with its upgrade description because I’m not noticing it at all. Third issue, the UI. - This game does not make it simple to build. Why do I need to go into my “skill book” to drag the recycle (delete) button. I tried having my builders dig an area and made a mistake so I tried to cancel it. Turns out you need to recycle the pole marker to stop it, this is not explained at all. - Please make it more clear on the failure of the battle screen which option is which. Because when I first read “restart wave” I thought that it would restart the incoming wave not the whole round. It should be restart round not wave, but that one could just be a me thing. Last issue, the game doesn’t explain how to gather anything else but wood. Using the Minecraft logic, you find stone blocks, mine stone blocks, then get stone right? Wrong, mining stone blocks gives you nothing. It take 5 hits to break the block and drops nothing. You actually have to find these rock formation and mine the rocks sticking out of the ground not the stone blocks in the ground. You actually get more stone in dirt blocks than you do mining actual stone blocks in the ground. Also, I still do not know how to get metal. This wasn’t explained at all, and I still don't know how to get metal and its needed for advance traps. This game has too many issues and it's almost unplayable due to the scaling issues. Struggling at wave 6 with enemies with 1.5k hp flying over your wall and killing you king in a minute is ridiculous. This game is new, and its trying to gain traction but it's a literal slog to get through the first hour of the game. The game is supposed to be fun, creative, tower defensive game but its so difficult at the moment it feels like your playing on a difficulty that's not normal. I dare not even think of higher difficulties, and I shouldn’t think that. I want the game and the devs to succeed but the whole point of the game is to have fun and the way the game is right now, there isn't a lot of fun to be had. It feels punishing to play and I refuse to play anymore until these issues are figured out. Updates: -Patch 5/1/26 adds a help menu that only covers the level editor and skirmish mode, not the campaign or how to gather other resources. But they did say the next patch will focus on balancing and progression so I will be looking forward to the next update.

This game is unbelievably amazing!! I always wanted to play a game like "Colony Survival" but its mechanics and graphics were a hard turn off for me. This game is exactly what I was looking for and is incredibly fun to play on and I highly recommend it for anyone who does! Unironically just sat down to merely hop in a see what it was like and 2 hours blew by so fast I was really surprised. Usually I pay attention to time in case of refund but this game genuinely had me hooked immediately! The building is extremely enjoyable, easy to use, and really intuitive to get into. Slightly confused with different types of blocks since you have to switch the type from like defense blocks to weapon placements, then use a different button to scroll through the different types in that group.. But honestly the controls are really solid! Using scroll to rotate is so simple I'm mind blown I haven't seen any other game use it! I think the tech tree for unlocking stuff is hard to get used to since it only shows a hand full of items which you have to double click to see more for each type.. I think it would be better to have it more of a traditional tech tree with the blocks in a list showing you different branches. That way you can see everything and not miss important blocks like "Fields" for food just because they were hidden behind another block. I also played on (UPDATE: Thought I was on easy but I was not!) "Mere Mortal" mode since the game allows you to choose your difficulty and had no issues completely curbstomping the enemy but maybe its completely different on other difficulties. I absolutely recommend this game on sale, in fact I would recommend it even full price because its truly amazing and its a game I'm going to sink a lot of time into 💖 I'm also going to promote this game to all of my friends as well!!! 💖 And for anyone struggling, the strats I used was to put myself in front of the enemy convoy and try to take as much aggro as possible while not getting hit so my ballista's behind me picked them off one by one. I also had layers of wood walls and corridors full of spike traps!

It's a very good game, it's still practically at it's young infantile stage, but it shows a lot of promise and the developers do listen to gamers and they acknowledge the issues that they have with the game, it's very fun and the building can be expansive as long as you are creative enough to go along with the building, overall a very good game despite it's first release.

I would give this a neutral rating if I could, but will keep it as a "Yes" as I did get my money's worth by getting this game on discount. The game has a very addictive gameplay loop, relatively good building systems and a laidback lore. However, it suffers from a few issues related to its core gameplay, the Wave Defense portion: - Mobs Path Finding. Most enemies feel like a "dumb" path-finding that often gets stuck in holes, stare blankly at your wall or just stop moving for no reason. This sucks the fun out of defenses, where your cannons/archers simply blast enemies as they get stuck in the moat you build. This path finding also applies to friendly units which often get stuck - Lack of "Progression". After surviving the first few waves, most monsters just start spawning in larger numbers and with ever increasing health bars. There is not much excitement in fighting the same enemy over and over again, but with larger numbers. (Also, they get stuck in holes anyways) - The 3rd world is also seriously bugged, as most enemies can't even reach your castle unless you build a bridge for them
